PR adds the DocsFn framework plus many `vitest.config.ts` files across packages. `dev` is green; failures are triggered by the PR's broader CI test scope (310 turbo tasks vs dev's narrower affected set).

---

1. Fix `@uifn/components-react#test` — dedupe React resolution (likely `vitest`/alias config or workspace hoisting so `uifn/react` doesn't pull a nested `react`).
2. Fix `@docsfn/core` `loadDocsConfig` test timeouts (raise timeout or speed up config loader on CI).
